Fun game. Will be much better as stuff gets polish. Hitboxes suck at the moment. 
Some enemies need to be smoothed out (especially for nightmare the highest difficulty) sometimes there's just damage you can't avoid because enemies attack as soon as you're in radius meaning there's situations when dodging you just can't avoid the damage.
Skulls feel like bullet sponges that do way too much damage to you from a overly bright attack you can kinda dodge but could be much better.
Slugs suck as a enemy especially elites. They explode so fast which adds to unavoidable damage. Big icky. Elites put so many pools down while being bullet sponges you can't really do much other than sit on a level for several minutes hoping you kill them before the map is covered in damage pools.

Gonna be a really good if they can follow the roadmap. Enemies already got an update so definitely has potential. Just really really unsmooth experiences here and there.

This game is extremely fun, even alone!
 What the game still lacks (which is ok, it's still in early access) are more of everything in my opinion, and I don't just mean maps, perks or weapons, but also modes. 
In my opinion there should definitely be a 1v1 mode where you can compete against your friends or a jump and run mode in which you play for the best times (I had a lot of fun with the jump and run sections of the game so far). 
These two modes were even announced in an earlier trailer, I really hope that they will also be in the finished game. 
In addition, I personally still lack a ranking list on which the best players in the game are honored.
What I have to mention is the overall gameplay as this is designed to be incredibly fun,
every weapon I've played has felt different and the movement is just so fun and clean you just can't stop to praise the game for it.
I look forward to a good future in this game!

I don't usually leave reviews on early access games because they may or may not be representative of the final product. However, after spending quite some time with it, I felt like it was my duty to say quite a few things:

PROS:
- The soundtrack...oh the sountrack.
- The combat feels so fun and fast paced, no matter your weapon.
- The graphics are phenomenal.
- The overall gameplay is quite fun and it can be addictive at times.

CONS:
- After a certain point in the game (after island 40 I believe), no matter how buffed I was, my weapon (the rocket launcher) was so underpowered that I could hear the enemies laughing at me as I shoot them (PD It doesn't actually happen in the game lol).
- There's no separate parkour mode, even though it was a feature that was teased before.

Is it worth it? Yes, it's a bit rough on the edges (par for the course for an early access game), but it's still an amazing game, no matter if you like EDM or not.

Smooth movement. Smooth weapons. Really cool upgrades and stage design. At first I thought that the downfall of this game would be the lack of variety in enemies but boy was I wrong. The fact that there's no microtransactions (and as far as I know none in the future) makes me actually have hope for the future and community around this game. Haven't experience any bugs so far either. And my potato of a computer is running this on high graphics pretty smoothly (yes i consider 48 fps smooth non-gamer brain go brr). Overall I'm really glad i picked up this game. Roguelikes like this, HLD, and RoR2 are my very favorite. I'm so happy to know that this game really wasn't an april fools day joke.
